1	/**
2	 * PluginDevWatcher — watches local-path plugin directories for file changes
3	 * and triggers worker restarts so plugin authors get a fast rebuild-and-reload
4	 * cycle without manually restarting the server.
5	 *
6	 * Only plugins installed from a local path (i.e. those with a non-null
7	 * `packagePath` in the DB) are watched. File changes in the plugin's package
8	 * directory trigger a debounced worker restart via the lifecycle manager.
9	 *
10	 * Uses chokidar rather than raw fs.watch so we get a production-grade watcher
11	 * backend across platforms and avoid exhausting file descriptors as quickly in
12	 * large dev workspaces.
13	 *
14	 * @see PLUGIN_SPEC.md §27.2 — Local Development Workflow
15	 */
16	import chokidar, { type FSWatcher } from "chokidar";
17	import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
18	import path from "node:path";
19	import { logger } from "../middleware/logger.js";
20	import type { PluginLifecycleManager } from "./plugin-lifecycle.js";
21	
22	const log = logger.child({ service: "plugin-dev-watcher" });
23	
24	/** Debounce interval for file changes (ms). */
25	const DEBOUNCE_MS = 500;
